title: (0Day) OpenAI ChatGPT Improper Input Validation Model Policy Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass policy restictions on affected versions of OpenAI ChatGPT. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the interface to the ChatGPT-Vision Data model. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it as a prompt to the model. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass model policy restrictions and obtain generated text concerning subjects in a picture.
